left: The part is not really built: no windows or doors reach the build. Shell and floors (parts/shell.mjs, the 'openings and reserved cells' carve around lines 60-80) sets every opening cell to air, and runParts treats air as owned, so no later part can fill them. Fix belongs in shell.mjs (leave opening cells unowned), which I did not touch; the removed glass and door calls are in /tmp/probe5/openings.orig.mjs for restoring once that lands.
The z33 sills and hoods now sit in front of empty holes at the back wall, so they look detached until the glass returns.
Outside openings.mjs, the palette check does not run on refused writes, so OFF-PALETTE would only have appeared once they were free; with the removal, none is reported.
